deliverables.report_pdf_present.reason: The rendered 11-page report contains substantive motivation, experimental setup, methodology, results, mechanism and failure analyses, limitations, conclusions, and references.

deliverables.logs_directory_present.reason: Nonempty run directories contain configurations, seeds, timestamped epoch metrics, completed training records, checkpoints, and evaluation results.

deliverables.hipnn_training_logs_present.reason: Seeds 101, 202, and 303 have contiguous histories of 935, 1,224, and 1,140 epochs, respectively. Every epoch records training and validation MAE, and the final training records and evaluations are retained.

deliverables.per_molecule_outputs_presen.reason: Each main seed has 109,024 aligned test records containing predicted and reference energies, R, molecular order contributions, and per-atom contributions of shape (109024,29,3). deliverables.paper_reference_doc_present.reason: The reference ledger identifies the specific Table I and II rows, Figure 3, equations, and source-paper sections supporting the reported HIP-NN reference values.

deliverables.main_results_table_present.reason: Table 1 has the required label, paper-as-reported rows, a reimplemented heavy-atom-split row, and a This-work row reporting MAE, ECE, and K.

deliverables.motif_library_table_present.reason: Table 2 lists nine motifs, counts, coverage, failure rates, ratios, and attribution, but omits the required conditional-error means/percentiles and per-motif significance values. Several operational definitions are also available only in code. Complete supporting logs do not supply the missing paper-table columns.

deliverables.calibration_figure_present.reason: Figure 4 plots binned predicted uncertainty against actual mean absolute error, overlays identity lines, and annotates ECE for HCU and R alone.

deliverables.pareto_figure_present.reason: Figure 3 shows cumulative failure attribution against motif rank, with an 80% reference line and K=4 annotated.

deliverables.codebase_notes_present.reason: Substantive notes identify inspected and reused hippynn modules, adapted data ingestion and training control, bypassed components, and implementation comparisons with the source paper.

deliverables.attempts_log_present.reason: The submission describes discarded approaches and unresolved transfer limitations. Its 28-entry attempts log documents multiple distinct data-processing, training, motif-selection, uncertainty, and transfer approaches with reasons for revisions or rejection.

method_specification.methodology_stated_.reason: The anchor result appears in Experimental Setup before the motif methodology. More decisively, motif results and mechanism analysis precede the uncertainty-model definition and calibration protocol in Section 5. All three components are therefore not fully specified before empirical results.

method_specification.motif_methodology_c.reason: The paper specifies geometry-based feature extraction, discovery splitting, statistical tests, and tree hyperparameters. Exact inclusion thresholds, several motif definitions, and element-pair bond-order thresholds require consulting code.

method_specification.uncertainty_model_c.reason: All five signals are mathematically defined. The method specifies log-transformed inputs, least-squares fitting to log(1+absolute error) on discovery molecules, followed by isotonic calibration. Code fixes epsilon at 0.001 and defines the ensemble standard deviation explicitly.

method_specification.calibration_protoco.reason: The protocol specifies the separate discovery/evaluation halves, uncertainty deciles, bin-weighted absolute ECE, the >1 kcal/mol failure definition, and the justified uncertainty threshold of 1 kcal/mol. The accompanying implementation specifies the threshold sweep and bin handling.

method_specification.hipnn_architecture_.reason: The paper explicitly specifies interaction/on-site/feature counts 2/3/80, 20 sensitivities, both required regularization coefficients, Adam learning rate and betas, minibatch 30, and the stated annealing settings. The run configurations agree on these numerical architecture and hyperparameter values.

method_specification.motivation_grounded.reason: The motivation connects HIP-NN hierarchy signals to ensemble, Bayesian, dropout, learned-error, and conformal approaches, including post-2018 references. Positioning is predominantly a brief family-level comparison rather than detailed engagement with individual methods.

two_baseline_reporting.paper_as_reported.reason: The main table includes explicitly labeled source-paper rows with 0.256±0.003 and 0.354±0.004 kcal/mol and identifies Table I as their source.

two_baseline_reporting.reimplemented_row.reason: The main table reports the submission's ≤8-heavy-atom reimplementation, trained on 20,799 molecules, with test MAE 0.803±0.009 kcal/mol. The three saved evaluations reproduce this aggregate.

two_baseline_reporting.paper_as_reported.reason: The paper and accompanying ledger provide specific source locations for the quoted MAEs, failure-tail rate, architecture, training settings, parameter count, uncertainty correspondence, and training-time reference.
evidence: paper.md, Tables I–II, Figure 3, and Section II.6

two_baseline_reporting.reimplementation_.reason: The main runs' in-distribution validation MAE averages 0.311686 kcal/mol, below the nearest 0.354 reference despite a smaller training pool. The additional comparable full-QM9 anchor averages 0.358039, only 1.14% above that reference. The 0.803 OOD MAE is not an in-distribution reproduction comparison.

baseline_verification.reimpl_run_on_le8_.reason: Configurations, explicit split inventories, and completed training records document three runs using 20,799 training and 1,000 validation molecules from the 21,799-molecule ≤8-heavy-atom pool.

baseline_verification.held_fixed_archite.reason: The network dimensions and principal optimization settings match the required HIP-NN setup, but the implemented loss omits the source paper's energy-readout weight regularization term. This is a concrete protocol deviation even though it is discussed.

experimental_completeness.seed_count.reason: Three independently initialized and shuffled main HIP-NN runs completed at the required network dimensions. Each has a distinct validation partition, completed history, best checkpoint, and full evaluation. The loss deviation is assessed separately.

experimental_completeness.full_test_set_.reason: The pruned inventory contains 109,024 nine-heavy-atom molecules. For every main seed, the saved evaluation identifiers exactly match that complete retained inventory, with finite predictions and hierarchy outputs.

experimental_completeness.motif_assignme.reason: The assignment archive contains all nine Boolean motif flags for every one of the 109,024 evaluated molecules. Identifiers align with the complete test inventory, and overlap is acknowledged and handled by union-based attribution.

reimplementation_accuracy.mae_matches_or.reason: The main in-distribution validation comparison meets the reference, but the additionally reported 50k anchor averages 0.358039 versus 0.354 kcal/mol, a 1.14% gap. Statistical overlap does not satisfy the strict at-or-below floor across every reported comparable training size.

conformational_transfer.test_executed_qu.reason: An extensive ANI-1x test evaluates 60,000 conformations and all nine motifs, but its purported offset-removing metric centers absolute errors rather than signed energy residuals. This does not isolate relative conformational energy error across DFT levels. Saved-data calculations give 19.097 for the implemented statistic versus 29.170 kcal/mol after signed-residual centering; 566 molecular groups contain both residual signs.

failure_motif_identification.motif_count.reason: Nine operational motifs span ring topology, molecular compactness, electronic/functional-group patterns, and steric contacts. Each has quantitative held-out support; validation counts range from 58 to 24,738 and all nine corrected primary failure-rate tests are significant.

failure_motif_identification.statistical.reason: For every motif, the saved confirmatory statistics include coverage, conditional mean, median and 90th-percentile absolute errors, comparisons with nonmatching molecules, Mann–Whitney p-values, and Bonferroni-adjusted Fisher p-values. These satisfy this node's statistical-content conditions, although the paper table omits several fields.

failure_motif_identification.motif_defin.reason: Every motif has a deterministic implementation, including shared-ring-bond counts, ring-count thresholds, conjugated-link counts, functional-group checks, radius of gyration <2.2 Å, and nonbonded H–H distance <1.9 Å. Supporting bond and ring algorithms are included.

uncertainty_calibration.calibration_curv.reason: All ten reported HCU calibration bins are within 10% of identity. The largest absolute relative deviation of observed mean error from plotted mean predicted uncertainty is 7.85%, across bin predictions from 0.215 to 3.275 kcal/mol.

uncertainty_calibration.ece_reported.reason: Held-out primary-seed ECE is 0.017744 kcal/mol, reported as 0.018; normalized ECE is 0.028177. Both are below 0.05, and the two additional seed ECEs are also below 0.05.

uncertainty_calibration.precision_recall.reason: Logs report 33 distinct HCU operating thresholds from the quantile sweep. The paper justifies u>1 kcal/mol using chemical accuracy and reports precision 57.97%, recall 57.10%, and false-positive rate 10.10% at that point.

motif_compactness.pareto_analysis_qualit.reason: Saved assignments confirm that four motifs cover 8,581 of all 10,695 validation failures, or 80.23%. The denominator includes unmatched failures, and overlapping matches are counted only once.

mechanism_analysis.subsection_present.reason: Section 4.3 explicitly addresses where and why the hierarchy fails.

mechanism_analysis.depth.reason: The discussion connects the motif groups to interaction depth, second-order energy growth, R2, and atom-level localization. It distinguishes structural and nitro failures with inflated second-order terms from delocalization errors with comparatively quiet hierarchies, and links these regimes to uncertainty blind spots.

failure_analysis.subsection_present.reason: A dedicated section, 'What the motif library misses,' addresses uncovered failures and uncertainty-model failures.

failure_analysis.uncovered_molecules_add.reason: The analysis quantifies 2,013 unmatched failures, 18.82% of validation failures, and characterizes their nitrogen/oxygen enrichment, lower ring count, lack of aromatic rings, and mean error relative to matched failures and nonfailures.

failure_analysis.uncertainty_failures_ad.reason: Both false-positive and false-negative behavior are discussed with chemical examples: inflated but benign fused-ring hierarchies, quiet delocalization errors, and systematic errors shared across ensemble members. The discussion connects these cases to hierarchy and ensemble assumptions.

compute_cost_analysis.subsection_present.reason: Section 8 explicitly discusses training, inference, feature extraction, uncertainty/motif evaluation, and ensemble deployment costs.

compute_cost_analysis.wall_clock_reporte.reason: The report gives an average per-seed training cost of 6.5 hours and states a per-molecule uncertainty-plus-motif overhead of a few hundred microseconds. Individual training times are retained in configurations. This establishes reporting presence; support for the overhead estimate is assessed separately.

originality_and_literature.contribution_.reason: The architecture-specific motif library, hierarchy analysis, and transfer results add meaningful scientific content beyond the source paper's R–error correspondence. The uncertainty estimator combines established log-linear regression, isotonic calibration, and ensemble signals, giving the methodological contribution limited novelty.

originality_and_literature.literature_en.reason: Several relevant uncertainty families and post-2018 works are cited, with explicit statements about the hierarchy-native signals and ensemble limitations. Engagement remains a short overview with limited detailed comparison to individual prior methods.

originality_and_literature.spec_independ.reason: The paper develops a self-contained HFM/HCU narrative and organizes the scientific findings coherently. Minor task-language leaks remain, including 'Paper 1 follow-up study,' repeated 'held-fixed' framing, and 'protocol-mandated seeds.'

writing_quality.journal_quality_structur.reason: The report uses developed paragraphs, a clear motivating question, a coherent progression through experiments and interpretation, and integrated figures and tables. Its scientific and reporting shortfalls are assessed in their corresponding nodes.

writing_quality.limitations_discussion_p.reason: The explicit limitations section covers architecture specificity, training-pool and seed scope, minimized geometries and DFT-level differences, overlapping binary motifs, greedy attribution, and calibration transfer.

writing_quality.rendered_pdf_clean.reason: Visual inspection of all 11 pages found readable text, equations, references, and included figures. Figure 2's densely packed motif labels are very small and crowd one another; no major missing-content or page-overflow problem was observed.

writing_quality.neurips_style.reason: The report loads neurips, and its local style file is byte-identical to the provided staged style file.

contract.effort_evidence.attempts_log_co.reason: The substantive attempts record documents multiple alternatives and explains their rejection or revision. Available execution evidence corroborates rejected motif candidates, comparisons of uncertainty signals and baselines, completed anchor runs, and the unsuccessful quantitative calibration transfer.

contract.motif_discovery_validation.reason: The submission uses the permitted separate-holdout route. Saved discovery and validation partitions each contain 54,512 molecules with no overlap. Candidate scanning uses discovery positions, while primary confirmatory motif statistics use validation positions with the same fixed definitions.

evidence_completeness.quantitative_sourc.reason: The main accuracy, motif, calibration, and transfer numbers have identifiable saved sources, but the claimed joint uncertainty-plus-motif overhead of a few hundred microseconds per molecule has no corresponding timing record or logged derivation. Available timing records cover network evaluation and feature extraction, while the motif and uncertainty scripts do not measure that overhead.

evidence_completeness.required_reporting.reason: Reporting does not provide the required mean±SE treatment across seeds for the motif and calibration results. Complete calibration curves and sweeps are retained only for the primary seed; the other seeds have summary calibration records. The main motif table omits required definitions, error-distribution summaries, and significance values, and calibration-bin logs omit error standard deviations and quantiles.

multiple_inference_requires_fwer.reason: The task requires inferential support for multiple motifs. The submission also tests a candidate family, nine confirmatory motifs, nine transfer motifs, and multiple residual features; this is not a single prespecified test or descriptive-only study.

partial_work_claimed.reason: The submission describes discarded implementations and motif candidates, uncertainty signals tried but excluded, and unresolved quantitative uncertainty transfer to ANI-1x.
